globalThis.comparison=(()=>{
  const checks={};const raises=work=>{try{work();return false;}catch(error){return error instanceof TypeError;}};
  const target=document.createElement(variant%2?'button':'div');
  checks.emptyNode=target.hasChildNodes()===false;
  target.appendChild(document.createComment('child'));
  checks.commentChild=target.hasChildNodes()===true;
  Object.defineProperty(target,'firstChild',{get(){throw new Error('page override');}});
  checks.ownedChildRead=target.hasChildNodes()===true;
  checks.leafNodes=!document.createTextNode('text').hasChildNodes()&&!document.createComment('comment').hasChildNodes()&&!document.createAttribute('attr').hasChildNodes();
  checks.nodeBrand=raises(()=>Node.prototype.hasChildNodes.call({}));
  checks.nodeDescriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Node.prototype,'hasChildNodes').enumerable===true && Node.prototype.hasChildNodes.length===0;
  checks.initialHandler=target.onclick===null;
  const order=[];let context=false;let eventIdentity=false;const event=new Event('click',{cancelable:true});
  target.addEventListener('click',()=>order.push('before'));
  target.onclick=function(e){context=this===target;eventIdentity=e===event;order.push('handler');return false;};
  target.addEventListener('click',()=>order.push('after'));
  checks.cancel=target.dispatchEvent(event)===false && event.defaultPrevented;
  checks.callback=context&&eventIdentity;
  checks.handlerOrder=order.join(',')==='before,handler,after';
  order.length=0;target.onclick=()=>order.push('replacement');target.dispatchEvent(new Event('click'));
  checks.replacementOrder=order.join(',')==='before,replacement,after';
  target.onclick=null;order.length=0;target.dispatchEvent(new Event('click'));
  checks.removed=order.join(',')==='before,after'&&target.onclick===null;
  target.onclick=()=>order.push('last');order.length=0;target.dispatchEvent(new Event('click'));
  checks.reactivatedOrder=order.join(',')==='before,after,last';
  const object={};target.onclick=object;checks.objectValue=target.onclick===object;
  order.length=0;target.dispatchEvent(new Event('click'));checks.nonCallable=order.join(',')==='before,after';
  target.onclick='text';checks.primitiveNull=target.onclick===null;
  target.onclick=()=>0;checks.falseOnly=target.dispatchEvent(new Event('click',{cancelable:true}));
  target.onclick=()=>false;const uncancelable=new Event('click');checks.uncancelable=target.dispatchEvent(uncancelable)&&!uncancelable.defaultPrevented;
  target.onclick=null;
  const svg=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');let svgCalled=false;svg.onclick=()=>{svgCalled=true;};svg.dispatchEvent(new Event('click'));checks.svgHandler=svgCalled;svg.onclick=null;
  let docCalled=false;document.onchange=()=>{docCalled=true;};document.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));checks.documentHandler=docCalled;document.onchange=null;
  let windowCalled=false;globalThis.oninput=()=>{windowCalled=true;};globalThis.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));checks.windowHandler=windowCalled;globalThis.oninput=null;
  checks.receiver=raises(()=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLElement.prototype,'onclick').get.call({}))&&raises(()=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLElement.prototype,'onclick').set.call(document,()=>{}));
  checks.descriptors=[HTMLElement.prototype,SVGElement.prototype,Document.prototype].every(proto=>['click','input','change','submit','reset','focus','blur','keydown','keyup','load'].every(type=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'on'+type)?.enumerable===true));
  const clickDescriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLElement.prototype,'onclick');
  checks.accessorNames=clickDescriptor.get.name==='get onclick' && clickDescriptor.set.name==='set onclick' && clickDescriptor.get.length===0 && clickDescriptor.set.length===1;
  return checks;
})();
